g.aria-label: Bone marrow aspirate · Source finding — Morphological, immunophenotypic, cytogenetic and molecular genetic examination of the bone marrow aspirate: active marrow, without significant pathological changes.
g.title: Bone marrow aspirate · Source finding — Morphological, immunophenotypic, cytogenetic and molecular genetic examination of the bone marrow aspirate: active marrow, without significant pathological changes.

g.aria-label: Haematopoietic changes · Source finding — Hypercellular bone marrow with reticulin fibrosis (MF-1) and reactive myeloid hyperplasia; no evidence of lymphoma involvement.
g.title: Haematopoietic changes · Source finding — Hypercellular bone marrow with reticulin fibrosis (MF-1) and reactive myeloid hyperplasia; no evidence of lymphoma involvement.

g.aria-label: MRI summary in record · Source finding — 10.05.2026: MRI features of a large splenic mass; deterioration compared with MRI of 31.08.2024.
g.title: MRI summary in record · Source finding — 10.05.2026: MRI features of a large splenic mass; deterioration compared with MRI of 31.08.2024.

g.aria-label: Marrow immunophenotype · Source finding — No immunophenotypic evidence of non-Hodgkin lymphoma infiltration was found in the bone marrow material examined (clinical query).
g.title: Marrow immunophenotype · Source finding — No immunophenotypic evidence of non-Hodgkin lymphoma infiltration was found in the bone marrow material examined (clinical query).

g.aria-label: Karyotype 46,XX[20] · Source finding — Summary: No detection of aberrations. Karyotype according to ISCN: 46,XX[20].
g.title: Karyotype 46,XX[20] · Source finding — Summary: No detection of aberrations. Karyotype according to ISCN: 46,XX[20].

g.aria-label: History since 2019 · Source finding — The patient considers herself unwell since 2019. Deterioration during the past year; intermittent investigations.
g.title: History since 2019 · Source finding — The patient considers herself unwell since 2019. Deterioration during the past year; intermittent investigations.

g.aria-label: Anaemia in history · Source finding — From 18.11.2024: hypochromic anaemia (haemoglobin 60 g/L), MCV 59 fL, low ferritin, thrombocytopenia 24 G/L, leucocytes 3 g/L as recorded. The leucocyte unit is unresolved.
g.title: Anaemia in history · Source finding — From 18.11.2024: hypochromic anaemia (haemoglobin 60 g/L), MCV 59 fL, low ferritin, thrombocytopenia 24 G/L, leucocytes 3 g/L as recorded. The leucocyte unit is unresolved.

g.aria-label: Abdominal lymph nodes · Source finding — Abdominal and retroperitoneal lymph nodes are not enlarged.
g.title: Abdominal lymph nodes · Source finding — Abdominal and retroperitoneal lymph nodes are not enlarged.

g.aria-label: Molecular panel · Source finding — No aberrations detected in the tested CALR, JAK2 (exon 12, V617F) and MPL targets. No BCR::ABL1 fusion transcript detected.
g.title: Molecular panel · Source finding — No aberrations detected in the tested CALR, JAK2 (exon 12, V617F) and MPL targets. No BCR::ABL1 fusion transcript detected.

g.aria-label: Spleen ultrasound · Source finding — Ultrasound findings: splenomegaly, chronic splenitis and simple splenic cysts. No evidence of portal or splenic vein thrombosis at the time of examination.
g.title: Spleen ultrasound · Source finding — Ultrasound findings: splenomegaly, chronic splenitis and simple splenic cysts. No evidence of portal or splenic vein thrombosis at the time of examination.

g.aria-label: Direct Coombs test · Source finding — Direct Coombs test: no antibodies to erythrocytes detected.
g.title: Direct Coombs test · Source finding — Direct Coombs test: no antibodies to erythrocytes detected.

g.aria-label: Vascularised lesion · Source finding — Spleen enlarged to 14.0 × 7.1 cm. Smooth, well-defined contours; homogeneous structure and normal echogenicity. Homogeneous isoechoic lesion 8.45 × 7.08 cm with an indistinct contour and marked Doppler blood flow.
g.title: Vascularised lesion · Source finding — Spleen enlarged to 14.0 × 7.1 cm. Smooth, well-defined contours; homogeneous structure and normal echogenicity. Homogeneous isoechoic lesion 8.45 × 7.08 cm with an indistinct contour and marked Doppler blood flow.

g.aria-label: Simple cysts · Source finding — Dimensions 157.0 × 79.0 mm. Smooth, well-defined contours; dense structure with hyperechoic inclusions. Three simple cysts up to 13.0 mm are described.
g.title: Simple cysts · Source finding — Dimensions 157.0 × 79.0 mm. Smooth, well-defined contours; dense structure with hyperechoic inclusions. Three simple cysts up to 13.0 mm are described.

g.aria-label: Venous patency · Source finding — Portal vein diameter 10.4 mm, patent, with unchanged spectral flow characteristics. Splenic vein diameter 5.5 mm, with unchanged spectral flow characteristics.
g.title: Venous patency · Source finding — Portal vein diameter 10.4 mm, patent, with unchanged spectral flow characteristics. Splenic vein diameter 5.5 mm, with unchanged spectral flow characteristics.

g.aria-label: Growth on serial MRI · Source finding — MRI features of a large splenic mass. Compared with MRI of 31.08.2024, deterioration with an increase in the size of the splenic mass.
g.title: Growth on serial MRI · Source finding — MRI features of a large splenic mass. Compared with MRI of 31.08.2024, deterioration with an increase in the size of the splenic mass.

g.aria-label: Haematologist’s suspicions · Source finding — Source diagnoses/suspicions: unspecified pancytopenia; chronic iron deficiency anaemia; splenic lymphoma? Evans syndrome? Gaucher disease? Portal venous system thrombosis with hypersplenism?
g.title: Haematologist’s suspicions · Source finding — Source diagnoses/suspicions: unspecified pancytopenia; chronic iron deficiency anaemia; splenic lymphoma? Evans syndrome? Gaucher disease? Portal venous system thrombosis with hypersplenism?

g.aria-label: MRI lesion features · Source finding — MRI features of a solid splenic lesion and biliary sludge.
g.title: MRI lesion features · Source finding — MRI features of a solid splenic lesion and biliary sludge.

g.aria-label: Spleen palpation · Source finding — Splenomegaly on palpation, 2–3 cm below the umbilical line, with an irregular surface.
g.title: Spleen palpation · Source finding — Splenomegaly on palpation, 2–3 cm below the umbilical line, with an irregular surface.

g.aria-label: WBC · units? · Source finding — WBC: 4.5 g/L; reference interval 4.0–9.0, as recorded. Unit requires clarification.
g.title: WBC · units? · Source finding — WBC: 4.5 g/L; reference interval 4.0–9.0, as recorded. Unit requires clarification.

g.aria-label: Blood smear · Source finding — Peripheral blood has few cells with an almost normal distribution; no blasts detected. Red-cell morphology is unremarkable; platelet numbers are reduced microscopically. Bone marrow is normocellular, with preserved granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic proportions. Blasts below 5%. Lymphoid cells are not increased and their morphology is unchanged. No morphological evidence of lymphoma. The cause of cytopenia remains unexplained. Correlation with histology and immunophenotyping is recommended in the report.
g.title: Blood smear · Source finding — Peripheral blood has few cells with an almost normal distribution; no blasts detected. Red-cell morphology is unremarkable; platelet numbers are reduced microscopically. Bone marrow is normocellular, with preserved granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic proportions. Blasts below 5%. Lymphoid cells are not increased and their morphology is unchanged. No morphological evidence of lymphoma. The cause of cytopenia remains unexplained. Correlation with histology and immunophenotyping is recommended in the report.

g.aria-label: Cystic areas 40 mm · Source finding — Spleen enlarged by a heterogeneous, mildly hyperintense solid mass, recorded as 170×108×11 mm, with more cystic areas measuring 40 mm and a heterogeneous area recorded as 60m with a haemorrhagic component. Moderate contrast enhancement. Compression of the left kidney, pancreas, stomach and bowel loops. The source strings 170×108×11 mm and 60m remain unresolved; they have not been reconstructed.
g.title: Cystic areas 40 mm · Source finding — Spleen enlarged by a heterogeneous, mildly hyperintense solid mass, recorded as 170×108×11 mm, with more cystic areas measuring 40 mm and a heterogeneous area recorded as 60m with a haemorrhagic component. Moderate contrast enhancement. Compression of the left kidney, pancreas, stomach and bowel loops. The source strings 170×108×11 mm and 60m remain unresolved; they have not been reconstructed.

g.aria-label: Platelets · units? · Source finding — PLT: 226 g/L; reference interval 180.0–320.0, as recorded. Unit requires clarification.
g.title: Platelets · units? · Source finding — PLT: 226 g/L; reference interval 180.0–320.0, as recorded. Unit requires clarification.

g.aria-label: Immunohistochemistry · Source finding — The source immunohistochemical conclusion states that the findings exclude bone marrow involvement by lymphoma.
g.title: Immunohistochemistry · Source finding — The source immunohistochemical conclusion states that the findings exclude bone marrow involvement by lymphoma.

g.aria-label: Lesion 142 mm · Source finding — Spleen enlarged by a mildly hyperintense solid lesion 85×112×142 mm, with cystic areas up to 24 mm and moderate contrast enhancement; compression of part of the pancreas and the left kidney.
g.title: Lesion 142 mm · Source finding — Spleen enlarged by a mildly hyperintense solid lesion 85×112×142 mm, with cystic areas up to 24 mm and moderate contrast enhancement; compression of part of the pancreas and the left kidney.

g.aria-label: Allergy in history · Source finding — Allergic reactions to ceftriaxone.
g.title: Allergy in history · Source finding — Allergic reactions to ceftriaxone.

g.aria-label: Hypersplenism in record · Source finding — Splenic neoplasm. Splenomegaly. Hypersplenism. Thrombocytopenia.
g.title: Hypersplenism in record · Source finding — Splenic neoplasm. Splenomegaly. Hypersplenism. Thrombocytopenia.

g.aria-label: Recorded code D48.9 · Source finding — D48.9: neoplasm of uncertain or unknown behaviour, unspecified site, as recorded.
g.title: Recorded code D48.9 · Source finding — D48.9: neoplasm of uncertain or unknown behaviour, unspecified site, as recorded.

g.aria-label: 20 metaphases · Source finding — 20 metaphases of bone marrow cultures analysed. No cytogenetic abnormalities detected. Patients with myeloproliferative neoplasms can have a normal karyotype; cytogenetics therefore neither confirms nor excludes the diagnosis. FISH on a bone marrow smear showed no MECOM rearrangement (3q26) in 100 interphase nuclei.
g.title: 20 metaphases · Source finding — 20 metaphases of bone marrow cultures analysed. No cytogenetic abnormalities detected. Patients with myeloproliferative neoplasms can have a normal karyotype; cytogenetics therefore neither confirms nor excludes the diagnosis. FISH on a bone marrow smear showed no MECOM rearrangement (3q26) in 100 interphase nuclei.

g.aria-label: Fibrosis MF-1 · Source finding — Hypercellular bone marrow with reticulin fibrosis (MF-1) and reactive myeloid hyperplasia; morphological changes suspicious for lymphoma involvement. Immunohistochemistry is required for verification according to the report.
g.title: Fibrosis MF-1 · Source finding — Hypercellular bone marrow with reticulin fibrosis (MF-1) and reactive myeloid hyperplasia; morphological changes suspicious for lymphoma involvement. Immunohistochemistry is required for verification according to the report.

g.aria-label: Marrow aspirate description · Source finding — Moderately cellular bone marrow aspirate. Erythropoiesis preserved without a shift to immature forms. Granulocytic lineage preserved, with maturation disturbance in immature forms. Megakaryocytic lineage reduced.
g.title: Marrow aspirate description · Source finding — Moderately cellular bone marrow aspirate. Erythropoiesis preserved without a shift to immature forms. Granulocytic lineage preserved, with maturation disturbance in immature forms. Megakaryocytic lineage reduced.

g.aria-label: Marrow infiltration · Source finding — Immature myeloid cells are present (2%). The source reports no evidence of bone marrow infiltration by lymphoma. Diagnosis in the source: no evidence of lymphoma.
g.title: Marrow infiltration · Source finding — Immature myeloid cells are present (2%). The source reports no evidence of bone marrow infiltration by lymphoma. Diagnosis in the source: no evidence of lymphoma.
